nodes.label: Reservation Concurrency Lock (SELECT FOR UPDATE)
nodes.rationale: Serialises last-unit contention per equipment row; prevents overbooking without full table lock.

nodes.label: Seed Script
nodes.rationale: upsert on every entity makes seed idempotent; safe to run on every boot.

nodes.label: CacheModule
nodes.rationale: enableOfflineQueue:false ensures Redis errors surface immediately to try/catch rather than queuing indefinitely.

nodes.label: Cache Namespace Versioning Strategy
nodes.rationale: Invalidation by INCR on a version counter avoids KEYS* scan; O(1) invalidation per namespace without key enumeration.

nodes.label: WarmupService
nodes.rationale: Populates cache on boot so first visitor is served from Redis, not Postgres.
